header: scripts/harvest-legs.ts: collects and saves the fares to every stop after Durgapur on the route of each train (with --station ASN: after ASANSOL, for the trains of the Asansol tab, into public.train_fare_leg_asn), while the plant's paid RailRadar month lasts (to 14 Dec 2026). The plant pays for the fare service, so I take the most from it: for each express/mail train that has fares (public.train_fare, filled by scripts/harvest-fares.ts) and for each stop after Durgapur, the fare of each class the train has, saved in public.train_fare_leg with the time received. For each LOCAL (MEMU) train the stops get the hint from the railway's fare table (no fare request). The card shows them under "Fares to every stop". Run scripts/harvest-fares.ts FIRST (it finds which classes each train has), then this: npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts everything not saved in the last 72 hours npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts --only 12019,13005 just these trains npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts --limit 10 at most 10 trains this time npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts --max-requests 3000 stop after about 3,000 requests (default 14,000) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts --gap-ms 3000 seconds between requests, in ms (default 3000 = 20 a minute, leaving room for the intranet itself) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts --no-locals | --no-express npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts --station ASN ... the same for the Asansol tab's trains (run harvest-fares.ts --station ASN first) npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/harvest-legs.ts list what is saved Cost: one request for each train's schedule, then one per class per stop (about 3 to 5 classes, 10 to 30 stops). A whole pass is several thousand requests of the 30,000 a month, at 20 a minute: ABOUT 15 HOURS for the whole 18,000. You can stop it at any time and run it again: a stop saved in the last 72 hours is not asked again. It stops at once if RailRadar says the limit is reached or the key is refused, and it refuses to run after FARES_LIVE_UNTIL.
